title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS must prevent the use of dictionary words for passwords.
check_content:
Verify Ubuntu 22.04 LTS prevents the use of dictionary words for passwords by using the following command: 
 
     $ grep -i dictcheck /etc/security/pwquality.conf 
     dictcheck = 1  
  
If "dictcheck" is not set to "1", is commented out, or is missing, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure Ubuntu 22.04 LTS to prevent the use of dictionary words for passwords. 
  
Add or modify the following line in the "/etc/security/pwquality.conf" file: 
  
dictcheck = 1
VulnDiscussion: If Ubuntu 22.04 LTS allows the user to select passwords based on dictionary words, then this increases the chances of password compromise by increasing the opportunity for successful guesses and brute-force attacks.
